recheck.desc: Single allowed live leg certifying the record is live. Heavy legs (n=6e5 totals) NOT recomputed.

params.continuous_part_only: ang > 0 (atom spike excluded, same convention as J09 B-check)

recheck.interpretation: W|traj ~ chi2_1 is exact BY CONSTRUCTION (Gaussian kicks; J02_moment_hierarchy.py:112), so per-bin KS scatter is Monte Carlo noise, not law signal. At n=158175/bin the median null KS is 0.00218 (0.868/sqrt(n)) -- the cited <=0.002 bound sits at the null median, so 3/8 bins meeting it and 5/8 exceeding it is binomial-consistent (P(>=5 of 8) = 36%). The p-value battery is uniform-compatible: 2/8 bins with p<0.05 (P(>=2 of 8) ~= 5.7% under null), min p = 0.0024 (P ~= 1.9% under null). Overall continuous-part KS = 0.000627 (p = 0.70), mean W = 1.0011 +/- 0.0013. KS p-value implementation validated: p(D=0.8274/sqrt(n)) = 0.4999, p(D=1.358/sqrt(n)) = 0.0499, simulated-null p-mean 0.525 / frac<0.05 = 0.035.

The J09c sentence 'KS <= 0.002 ... every D-bin, every cloud' is an unbacked citation; it is NOT reproduced here. A per-cloud KS table for those clouds would be a future run, not claimed here.
J09c_tail_audit.py's own output (pure chi2_1 shortfall table at n=6e5) was never captured (.out absent); its textual claims are cited as script content only, not recorded numbers.

Per-bin mean-W of bin 7 (large-D tail) = 1.0136 (+3.8 sigma vs 0.00356 slip SE) -- largest fluctuation of the battery; consistent with noise given 8 independent bins and the exact-by-construction status, but flagged for completeness.
